newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Peugeot still plans car plant in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot still plans car plant in Brazil.

text.p: French carmaker Peugeot SA denied a newspaper report saying it has indefinitely postponed its plans to build a car plant in Brazil, said a company spokeswoman in Brazil.
"That report is untrue," the spokeswoman said.
She said the company is still holding talks with the Brazilian states of Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro on where to locate the plant.
"We had meetings last week. We are still in the stage of negotiations, but everything is going fine," she said.
She could not predict when the French company will announce the plant's location.

Jornal do Brasil newspaper on Monday said Peugeot has halted its production plans in Brazil, without giving a reason for the decision. It also said that Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles had already informed Peugeot's decision to the state governments of Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro.
The newspaper also said Peugeot representatives in Brazil last week asked to cancel a June 16 meeting with President Fernando Henrique Cardoso when they would announce the location of the plant.
The spokeswoman said there was never a scheduled meeting with Cardoso.
